reason: v1 never exposed the baseline to its relieving action, so it could not distinguish memory failure from absent action-outcome support

arms.B: same affordance policy with policy retrieval only; SIM_LUANTI_EPISODIC=policy

controls: fresh reset world and newborn checkpoint per arm
same genome identity, runtime seed, map seed, game configuration, spawn and stopping rule within each pair
prediction retrieval disabled in both arms
no action override and no outcome label or task reward enters Rust
consequences enter Rust only through ordinary VoxeLibre health, hunger and pain interoception
non-choice primitives have no assigned bodily consequence

choice.forward_thrust: lose four VoxeLibre hit points for the next observation
choice.backward_thrust: gain four VoxeLibre hunger units for the next observation
choice.reset: after every observation the experimenter returns position, velocity, health and hunger to the common pre-choice state; the Rust action and learning state are never overridden

fixture_validity.each_A_warmup_requires: at least 4 forward and 4 backward choices
fixture_validity.each_arm_requires: exactly 40 scored eligible choices and at least one observation of every applied consequence
fixture_validity.invalid_fixture_rule: failure of exposure or opportunity invalidates the fixture and cannot count as a memory result

primary_success_rule.aggregate: during scored choices B has fewer injuries and more resource returns than A
primary_success_rule.paired: resource-return rate delta B-A is positive in at least 5 of 6 seeds and negative in none
primary_success_rule.mediation: B records at least one positive-body episode, retrieves it, produces positive score delta, changes an action, and the delayed observation records the corresponding positive outcome

failure_rule: Any unmet primary success condition fails the episodic gate; these seeds are consumed after one paired run and thresholds are not changed from their outcomes.
